facts.fact: The Eswatini Data Protection Act 2022 is in force and the EDPA issued an enforcement notice under its section 41 in June 2024.
Section 5 of the Data Protection Act 2022 designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, which acted in this notice.

The EDPA found MTN Eswatini in breach of sections 14(1)(b) and 14(2) over a mobile money statement shared with a third party, imposed a warning and directed eleven measures, with a report due in three months.
